notes.title: FULL REMAKE COMING FALL 2025
notes.content:
Coming soon, CURSED is getting remade from the ground up! 2 modes to play, Classic and Enhanced. The latter contains lots of new content! 
new enemies, enhanced combat with stats, new areas , puzzles, etc.
